policy.timeline_label_policy: keep semantic ids stable; hardware tracks may add an explicit pipe qualifier such as compute_util [matrix_core] or simd_util [SIMD/CU]
policy.amd_tensor_util_rocprofv3_role: optional independent calibration/fallback only; never the primary source
policy.amd_same_run_timestamp_pairing: Pair each kernel dispatch slice with a raw ROCm PM counter sample from the same rocprof-sys Perfetto proto by same-dispatch start timestamp and a declared tolerance; never splice another run.

metrics.meaning: Compute-pipeline utilization. On the MI308X MFMA/GEMM route this is Matrix Core utilization derived from same-run raw ROCm PM counters. SIMD/CU utilization is the separate auxiliary simd_util curve.

amd.collection: rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events; kernel dispatch slices and raw ROCm PM counter tracks share one Perfetto proto
amd.derivation: For a matched MFMA/GEMM kernel, pair the same-run raw counter sample to the dispatch start timestamp. For MI308X defaults, 80*4/4 gives 80 SIMD lanes per XCC. Expose the derived value as both compute_util and tensor_util. Never substitute SIMD_UTILIZATION, GPU_UTIL, CUDA-core utilization, GPU GFX Busy, or GPU UMC Busy.
amd.rocprofv3_fallback: rocprofv3:MfmaUtil is optional independent calibration/fallback evidence. Use it directly as a percent without multiplying by 100, label its provenance, and keep it separate from the primary same-run rocprof-sys series.
amd.unavailable_rule: If the kernel route is not MFMA/GEMM, either raw counter or a valid denominator is absent, mark compute_util and tensor_util unavailable with a reason. Never fill zero. A rocprofv3 calibration value does not make a missing same-run series measured.

metrics.meaning: HBM/DRAM utilization. Directional read/write counters stay as supporting series.

nvidia.combine: max(read,write) as a lower-bound utilization, plus directional curves

amd.collection: same-run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events; pair the raw counter sample to the same dispatch by start timestamp
amd.derivation: Sum HBM read and write requests, multiply by the explicit 64 B/request model, divide by the paired dispatch duration and the measured 3684 GB/s peak, then multiply by 100. Keep directional read/write series and label the result explicitly as an estimate.
amd.unavailable_rule: If either DRAM request counter, the dispatch duration, or the measured peak is absent or invalid, mark memory_util and its directional series unavailable with a reason. Never fill zero for missing evidence.

metrics.meaning: Intra-node interconnect utilization (NVLink on NVIDIA, xGMI P2P on AMD). Same-host NVLink/xGMI and cross-host NIC/RDMA evidence MUST remain strictly separated; multi-node traces label this curve explicitly as Intra-Node NVLink/xGMI and report Inter-Node RDMA NIC on a separate rdma_util curve (or omit with an explicit HCA footnote — never zero-fill).

nvidia.cross_host: NIC-side counters required (/sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/*/hw_counters or netdev statistics); GPU NVLink counters do not prove RDMA traffic

amd.dcs_continuous_sampling: rocprofiler-sdk device_counting_service (DCS) supports ~80 us intra-kernel PMC sampling on the 100 MHz HSA/s_memrealtime clock alongside host RDMA NIC sysfs pread() for EP16+ multi-node timelines
amd.same_dispatch_requirement: Requires an XGMI, RDMA, or fabric counter collected in the same run and paired to the same dispatch. Cross-host bandwidth also requires NIC-side evidence.
proxies_not_utilization: EA requests minus HBM DRAM requests
amd-smi GPU busy or memory busy
amd.unavailable_rule: When no same-dispatch XGMI/RDMA/fabric counter exists, mark communication_util unavailable with a reason. Never invent zero, never derive it from GMI credit-stall cycles or an EA-minus-DRAM request difference, and never use amd-smi as a substitute. On multi-node HCA where GPU-initiated RDMA bypasses host sysfs counters, omit rdma_util with a one-line unavailable footnote instead of drawing a fake zero line.

metrics.meaning: Fraction of physical SM/CU resources active over the strict kernel window. This is not Tensor Core utilization.

amd.derivation: Use same-run rocprof-sys GPU_UTIL as percent device-level GPU activity when present. Do not relabel it as tensor_util or compute_util.
amd.unavailable_rule: If GPU_UTIL is absent or outside its percent range, mark sm_active unavailable with a reason; never fill zero.

supporting_series.rocprofv3_calibration: optional independent rocprofv3:MfmaUtil fallback; not the primary source
supporting_series.unavailable_rule: non-MFMA/GEMM route or missing/invalid raw counters; never zero-filled and never derived from SIMD, GPU_UTIL, or amd-smi GPU busy
missing or out-of-range SIMD_UTILIZATION; do not relabel as tensor_util

supporting_series.source: real host NIC hardware counters (/sys/class/infiniband/*/ports/*/hw_counters or /sys/class/net/*/statistics)
supporting_series.unavailable_rule: On multi-node clusters where GPU-initiated RDMA bypasses host-readable HCA sysfs counters, omit rdma_util with an explicit one-line Panel A footnote instead of drawing a flat zero line.
